name: cangjie-lsp
description: Cangjie language services via the cj-lang Rust LSPServer (diagnostics, completion, hover, definition, references). Independent of the official cangjie extension.

cangjie.lsp.serverPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to the built LSPServer binary (from `cargo build -p cj-lsp`). Falls back to the `CANGJIE_LSPSERVER` environment variable when unset.

cangjie.lsp.extraArgs.description: Extra command-line arguments appended to LSPServer on startup.

cangjie.lsp.env.description: Extra environment variables for the LSPServer process, merged over the current process env (e.g. LD_LIBRARY_PATH for the Cangjie macro runtime).

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit --allowJs --checkJs --strict false --module node16 --target es2020 --moduleResolution node16 --lib es2020 --types node,vscode --skipLibCheck out/extension.js
